name: Ring of Shooting Stars
description: A ring of dark metal set with a stone that holds a night sky.
body:
## What it does

In dim light or darkness you can call up dancing lights or light whenever you like, and once a day faerie fire.

## Charges

It holds six and regains 1d6 each dawn. Spend two for ball lightning: one to four spheres of lightning that you steer, each striking the first creature that comes near it, a single sphere for 4d12 and more spheres for less each. Spend one to three for shooting stars: each a mote of light that bursts in a 15-foot cube for 5d4 fire damage.

spells.name: Dancing Lights
spells.note: at will, in dim light or darkness

spells.name: Light
spells.note: at will, in dim light or darkness

spells.name: Faerie Fire
spells.note: once per dawn, in dim light or darkness

features.name: Ball Lightning
features.text: 2 charges: one to four spheres of lightning for up to a minute, with concentration. A creature other than you that comes within 5 feet of one makes a DC 15 Dexterity save as it discharges, taking 4d12 lightning damage if there was one sphere, 5d4 for two, 2d6 for three or 2d4 for four.

features.name: Shooting Stars
features.text: 1 to 3 charges: each star bursts in a 15-foot cube, and each creature there makes a DC 15 Dexterity save, taking 5d4 fire damage on a failure and half on a success.
